request: Create full personal histories for the five approved existing player characters; assess future priorities by reader impact and primary quest consequences.

scope.limits: Discovery across overlapping caches is not exhaustive reading. Selected complete quest exchanges, rulings and endings plus compatible public Gate, library, coast, wall and Tower scenes were reviewed. Raw transcripts, controller information, intimate material, unreviewed attachments and protected sources remain external.

decisions: Five already-listed players gain personal pages. Their identities, original portraits and player roles remain. No new NPC, generic helper or joke identity is created.

Leo Haze is a Shadar-kai sorcerer. The quest establishes his Alavara participation, siege death and later contaminated undead confrontation; no restoration to living life is inferred. A later merchant sharing the name is not merged. The explicit encounter ending is retained without inventing later Dorian continuity.

Gudlaug and Beefy Boy win the race. His deliberate reputation-building, god claims, cheating, practical aid, imposed corruption, attack, apology and possessive concern for Tricks remain together. No godhood, permanent allegiance or later fate is confirmed.

Empty explicitly accepts the Pale Man bargain in the quest. His later recollection that he refused and later immunity claim do not overwrite the bargain or narrated contamination. Shared controller-label search matches are not identity evidence. Shadow Road recruitment remains a plan.

Alyhotep’s religious mission and account of necromancy remain attributed. The Eovar inspector identifies his frog helper as undead and he acknowledges it; later denials do not override that quest outcome. Public works are shared achievements. Thorn’s wish resurrection is initiated, not declared completed; the Tower petition has no granted divine answer in the reviewed scene.

Nerias’s claimed divine role remains attributed. The machine quest ends with three captives and the toymaker already dead; the Squiddy quest explicitly returns Squiddy alive. His limited sight, failed footing, recovery, instructions, harvesting, music and humor survive beside his care. A desired Gael journey is not a confirmed arrival.
Vaemyr gains four reciprocal links and the Azarian Peaks chronicle two, with every existing word, section, chapter, quotation and evidence field unchanged.

Existing Interregional/World Changing events already have 35 dedicated chronicles. Consequence-based importance and unclosed or mislinked quest endings deserve a focused future audit; no additional event or importance change is authorized or implemented by this observation.

preservation.worldDelta: Only the five existing player entries in two registries, plus five fixed paths/order/navigation items.
preservation.existingRecordDelta: Six link-only additions across Vaemyr and Azarian Peaks; metadata and all words retained.

checks.local: Canonical integrity, portraits, unchanged browse previews, protected assets, calendar and source receipts pass. Focused Chrome checks cover five directory routes, 101 canonical paragraphs/45 evidence panels, portraits, roster roles, aliases, saved chapters, fresh 390/320 layouts, eight connected links, five mobile sidebar routes and search without script/public HTTP errors. Representative screenshots inspected.
checks.hosted: The existing biography gate expands from 57 to 62 People profiles in place; no workflow stage or dependency is added. Hosted and production checks pending publication.
